meta.name: debug-hooks
meta.description: Systematic hook debugging workflow. Use when hooks aren't firing, producing wrong output, or behaving unexpectedly.

copy.tagline: 系统排查钩子不触发或行为异常的问题
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果钩子不触发或输出异常，需要系统化定位根因。
copy.tagline_en: Systematically debug hooks that don't fire or behave unexpectedly
copy.fit_line_en: For you if hooks aren't firing or produce wrong output and you need systematic root cause analysis.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按步骤检查钩子是否触发、输出是否正确，并给出修复建议。
howto.when: 当钩子不触发、输出错误或行为异常时，用户可要求调试钩子。

say.text: 帮我调试一下钩子，它没有触发。
say.note: Claude 会检查钩子注册和文件。

say.text: 检查钩子是否有静默失败。
say.note: Claude 会查找 detached spawn 等模式。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will systematically check if hooks are firing, producing correct output, and suggest fixes.
howto.when_en: When hooks aren't firing, produce wrong output, or behave unexpectedly, users can ask to debug hooks.

say_en.text: Debug my hooks, they aren't firing.
say_en.note: Claude will check registration and files.

say_en.text: Check for silent failures in hooks.
say_en.note: Claude will look for detached spawn patterns.
